hero.description: I build high-performance web applications with modern frameworks and clean backend systems — enhanced by real-world experience in data and AI
hero.cvLabel: Open my resume in a new tab

description: Web product design: Structure, interface and visual decisions driven by the product's goal, prioritizing clarity and ease of use.
Frontend development: Responsive, accessible and maintainable interfaces with React, TypeScript and Tailwind, built for production.
Backend development: REST APIs with FastAPI, database modeling and management (PostgreSQL, Supabase, MongoDB) and user authentication.
Delivery and launch: Technical preparation, deployment (Vercel, Render/Railway) and support until the product is live in production.
Data analysis: Data cleaning, processing and automation (Python, ETL), with dashboards and reports that support decision-making.
AI integrations: RAG-based agents and assistants (ChromaDB, Qdrant, LlamaIndex, LLMs), connected to your work tools.

Developed an AI agent based on a RAG architecture (LlamaIndex, ChromaDB/Qdrant, Groq LLM) for training and onboarding new team members, with a FastAPI backend and Slack integration for direct queries from the team channel.
Designed and maintained Python ETL pipelines that extract data from FTP, APIs and Google Sheets, then transform and consolidate it automatically, eliminating manual data entry.
Built dynamic Looker Studio dashboards to visualize KPIs and operational metrics, including campaign analytics and marketing funnels, to support decision-making.
Implemented web scraping with Playwright to automate data extraction from various web sources and feed the analysis and reporting processes.
Analyzed WhatsApp campaign data (failure rate and lead volume trends) using Python (pandas, numpy), Excel and Google Sheets.

items.company: EXPERTA Project (Unión Temporal Fessanjose y Triángulo)
description: Automated workflows with Python, reducing repetitive manual tasks.
Cleaned and refined the characterization databases through ETL processes, removing duplicates and failed records to keep only valid candidates for analysis and follow-up.
Designed Power BI dashboards and, together with the team, presented the results to evaluate campaign performance and adjust decisions.
Managed research for the planning and execution of the project, and implemented indicator monitoring and mitigation strategies.
Analyzed data in Python, Excel and Google Sheets to identify progress, gaps and needs of the population served.
Entered and managed data in systems such as BIZAGI and SUIFP SGR.
Contributed to building the structure and components of projects: objectives, activities, budget, schedule and required resources.
Configured and structured public investment projects in MGA-Web, aligned with the DNP's General Adjusted Methodology.
Formulated, structured and monitored investment projects with various funding sources.
